title: Board Play Lod Measures Wiring
description: Wire Rust BoardHost automatic_lod + forced_draw_lod, WASM setAutomaticLod/setForcedDrawLodLabel, BoardRenderer/BoardCanvas props, and board play floating window measures (Automatic LOD toggle + LOD tier select when off) so LOD controls are visible in board play.
summary: Board play refactor had dropped all window measures and BoardRenderer automatic/pinned LOD WASM sync. Restored single per-pane LOD select (Automatic, Minimap, Overview, Normal, Detail, Micro) via boardWindowKindsWithLodMeasures; wired BoardCanvas automaticLod/lod from boardLodModeByPane; re-added BoardRenderer setAutomaticLod/setForcedDrawLod and WASM push. Stable onBoardPlayActiveWindowChange + UICanvas callback refs avoid Golden Layout teardown on LOD changes.
